title: TransitEye Incident Schema
description: Schema for traffic violations, safety hazards, and ANPR incident records

id.description: Unique identifier for the incident record

plate_text.description: Recognized vehicle license plate characters or UNKNOWN

plate_confidence.description: OCR confidence score for the license plate extraction

trigger_reason.description: Violation or hazard trigger (e.g. bus_lane_violation, reckless_overtake, red_light)

clip_url.description: URI or storage key for associated video/evidence clip snippet

metadata.description: Additional context (e.g. vehicle category, relative speed, lane identifier)
